reason: The scenario is made of rendered measurements (page height at most 2,600 px, the Graph and Edit the flow tops within 8 px, the Diagnostics heading bottom and the Save version bottom at most 860, the drawing top under 860) plus an axe run and a banner-height check. The source does hold the two xl:grid-cols-2 grids, the Section ids and the clamp() editor height, and e2e/test_m6b_workspace.py asserts exactly these numbers, but I cannot run a browser and the heights depend on fonts, paddings and the graph's rendered size. The verifier's own generated test for this criterion failed at the head twice and I cannot read its screenshot or trace. A person with the e2e stack should look at test-results for C-592f8050 before this is accepted.

question: Q-002
reason: The link list, hrefs, target ids, single navigation landmark, sticky classes and scroll margin are all deterministic consequences of the code I read in workspace.ts, FlowEditorPage.tsx, Section.tsx, Shell.tsx, 75-flow-graph.tsx, 80-runs.tsx and the panel constants. The scenario's only rendering-dependent claims (bar top 0, target top at least bar height minus 1) follow from sticky top-0 and scroll-mt-16 with no scrolling ancestor inside main. The existing browser test matches the scenario line by line.

The browser test asserts the six links, their order, hrefs, single targets, the one navigation, the URL hash and the sticky positions.
